main_text.l: Sic Lectus. Auditus, Latus sim vel fuerim, sis vel
fueris, sit vel fuerit, &c.
Primum plusquam perfectum tempus.
Amatus eram vel fueram, ich was geliebet / eras,
vel fueras, erat vel fuerat, amati eramus vel fueramus,
eratis, vel fueratis, erant vel fuerant.
Doctus eram vel fueram, ich was gelehret / eras
vel fueras, erat vel fuerat, docti eramus vel fueramus,
eratis vel fueratis, erant vel fuerant.
Sic Lectus, Auditus, Latus eram vel fueram, eras
vel fueras, erat vel fuerat, &c.
Secundum plusquam perfectum tempus.
Amatus essem vel fuissem, ich were geliebet
worden / esses vel fuisses, esset vel fuisset, amati essemus
vel fuissemus, essetis vel fuissetis, essent vel fuissent.
Doctus essem vel fuissem, ich were gelehret
worden/esses vel fuisses, esset vel fuisset, docti essemus vel
fuissemus, essetis vel fuissetis, essent vel fuissent.
Sic Lectus, Auditus, Latus essem vel fuissem, esses
vel fuisses, esset vel fuisset, &c.
Scimus quidem perfectorum temporum peri-
phrasin ad Syntaxin pertinere: tamen ne studiosi de
Ramea Grammatices difficultate quererentur, vo-
luimus circunloquendi
formam subjicere.
Primum futurum tempus.
Amabor, ich wil oder werde oder sol geliebet
werden / amaberis vel amabere, amabitur, amabimur, a-
mabimini, amabuntur.
Docebor, doceberis vel docebere, docebitur, do-
cebimur, docebimini, docebuntur.
Legar, legeris vel legere, legetur, legemur, lege-
mini, legentur.
Audiar, audieris vel audiere, audietur, audiemur,
audiemini, audientur.
Ferar,

page.notes: Printed German words in black letter within the Latin text are rendered in plain type here; the page shows heavy mixed black letter and roman for German glosses. The word "Ramea" (Ramea Grammatices) appears as printed, likely Ramea (Ramus). Line "Ferar," at the foot is a catchword-like fragment and is kept as the last line of text. Some lines are faint at the edges; the reading of "Doctus eram" German gloss "gelehret" is taken from the scan with [?] where uncertain. Paragraph breaks in the verb paradigm lines are set by the printer's indents as best read.
